✨ 005 更灵动的拖拽排序

做横向或纵向的拖拽排序时，让落点两侧的元素轻轻让开，并且由近及远依次启动，动作会更像真实世界里的推挤。

Prompt 附在最后，可以直接抄 ⬇️

要点：
1. 光标及时反馈：悬停时变成手指，按下时变成抓手；
2. 落点用一条插入线提示：出现时从中间轻轻展开，拖动时跟着移到新的落点；
3. 插入线两侧的元素向外避让，离得越近，让得越多、动得越早：
位移 = 10px × 0.7ⁿ
延迟 = 24ms × n
（n 是与插入线相隔的层数，紧挨着的为 0）

可以直接喂给 AI 的部分：

Make drag-to-reorder in my product feel like this. Apply it to the lists,
rows and docks I name, and reuse any drag helper the project already has.

1. Cursor: a pointing hand over anything draggable, a grabbing hand while
   dragging.
2. Lift: the picked item follows the pointer, raised off the list so it
   never hides where it will land: above a horizontal row, or pulled aside
   and shrunk to about 90% in a vertical list. Its old slot closes up.
3. Drop hint: a faint, thin line in the gap where it will land (vertical in
   a row, horizontal in a list), about 15% of the text color. It grows from
   its middle when it appears and glides to each new gap. No line over the
   item's own slot.
4. Ripple: items on both sides of the line lean away from it. Counting n
   from the line (0 = the item touching it), item n moves
   A x 0.7^n (A is about 10px for icons, 8px for cards)
   and starts 24ms x n later, on a quick spring that barely overshoots and
   settles in about 0.25s. Nearer items move sooner and further, so the
   push spreads out like a ripple.
5. Drop: the item takes the gap and every item springs into its new place.
   Escape or dropping outside the list cancels, and everything springs back.
6. Give each motion its own curve (hand-like for the pointer, a small pop
   for the lift, springs for settling) instead of one ease-out everywhere.

Move things with transforms, not layout. Let the keyboard reorder too, and
with reduced motion keep only the line.

核心法则——降低非必要的体积表现

AI 容易把简单符号或者卡通化的设计置入严谨的空间和物理结构中理解，因此，可以用以下几个原则来改造你的图标:

1. For 主体：非必要不使用过多高光、阴影笔触，尽量使用简单的线性或者径向渐变来构建主体；

2. For 主体：非必要尽量让环境光影响主体；

3. For 背景：考虑不同圆角下的裁切适配，避免添加多余的弥散光和材质；用纯粹的线性渐变，渐变色值取同色相不同亮度，或者不同色相但鲜亮的颜色；

4. For 全局：尽量不要使用内发光、内阴影来体现质感，除非我要求

5. For 全局：高光不要只加亮，那样会变灰；阴影用相近色相更深一点的颜色，不要直接掺黑。

最后，让 AI 导出分层 PNG，以及背景参数，导入 Icon Composer 一键适配液态玻璃。

✨ 004 使用递进式圆角数值 + 连续曲率圆角（超椭圆）

001–004 都在我主页，关注我，每天一个让产品更有质感的小技巧

👉要点一：等距内缩。当你想让表单、嵌套卡片的各种元素看起来更规整的时候，使用递进式圆角。保证每一层都遵守：

内圆角 = 外圆角 − 间距，内外共用一个圆心

👉要点二：连续圆角/超椭圆。普通圆角接直边的地方有一道折痕，连续圆角过渡更顺（类比 iOS）： 

border-radius: 32px
corner-shape: superellipse(1.25)

Chrome / Edge 139+ 支持；Safari、Firefox 暂不支持，会自动退回普通圆角。

Make the corner radii in this UI consistent, then switch them to continuous corners. Work on the screen or components I name; ask me if I have not named them. If the project has radius tokens, change those instead of hard-coding values.

Inner radius = outer radius - padding (r = R - p)
Go from the outside in: dialog or card -> panels, inputs, buttons -> chips and tags. A box p inside a container with radius R gets R - p, so both corners share one center. Example: dialog 32, padding 16 -> panels and buttons 16; a chip 8 inside a 16 panel -> 8.
Boxes on the same level share one radius. Never go below 4.

Pills and circles stay fully round.
Keep every padding, gap and radius on a 4px grid.
Continuous corners
Keep border-radius and add the curve as progressive enhancement: @ supports (corner-shape: superellipse(1.25)) { :where(*) { corner-shape: superellipse(1.25); } } Set corner-shape: round on pills and circles.

Chrome and Edge 139+ render it; Safari and Firefox skip the block and show the plain border-radius.
When done, list every radius you changed as "element: old -> new".

# Small animations for a product site's feature tiles

Give every tile in my site's feature grid a small animation: a tiny scene that shows what the feature does.

## 0. Before you build
- Read the project: find out the tech stack (plain HTML/CSS, React, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Tailwind, Framer Motion…) and build it the way the project already does. Don't add an animation library unless the project already uses one.
- Ask me which look to use:
  A. The Lumno material below, as written.
  B. My product's own style: take the colors, radii, borders and shadows from my existing design tokens and components, and keep only the structure and motion rules from this prompt.
  C. A mix: the Lumno material in my brand's accent color and radii.
- Picking features: if I named features, animate those. If not, read the product's site, docs or code, list 3–5 features that a short scene can explain, and let me pick.

## 1. Lumno material (option A)
Overall: quiet, neutral, precise. Hairlines instead of borders, soft shadows tinted warm, no gradients or color washes, one accent color.

- Grid: one card with an outer radius of 28px. Cells are separated by 1px hairlines (a 1px grid gap over a hairline color). Cells are white. The card has a faint hairline ring and a soft shadow.
- Art panel: inset 8px from the cell edge, with a radius of the card radius minus the inset (20px), so corners stay concentric.
  - Fill #fafafa, plus an inner 1px ring: box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(32,38,46,.07).
  - Texture: background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgba(32,38,46,.06) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px).
  - The scene sits centred on the panel, about 126×118px.
- Text bars: body bars 4px tall with a 2px radius in #e5e9ef; heading bars 5px tall in #cdd4de. Vary the widths (34–92px).
- Mini windows and cards: white with a 9px radius.
  - Shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(47,42,34,.06), 0 8px 20px -10px rgba(47,42,34,.25).
  - Tab strip: 20px tall, #eef1f5. Tabs: 16px tall with 6px top corners; the active tab is white.
  - Favicons: 10px.
- Inner surfaces such as charts or fields: #f4f6fa. Secondary data: #b9c9e0. Accent: #3462ad, used only on the result.
- Icon chip (top-left of each tile): 32px, 10px radius, 1px border rgba(32,38,46,.1), white, shadow 0 1px 2px rgba(32,38,46,.05), a line-style glyph in #4b5563.
- Text color: a warm near-black, #2f2a22.
- Hover: the cell darkens to about 2.5% grey; the panel goes to #f4f5f6 with its ring at .09; the icon chip grows 32→36px from its top-left corner, its glyph turns to the text color, and its shadow deepens slightly.
- Dark mode (suggested values; keep the same relationships):
  - Cells #17181a, panel #1d1f22, inner ring rgba(255,255,255,.06), texture rgba(255,255,255,.04).
  - Body bars #2c2f34, heading bars #3a3e45.
  - Windows #24272b with a 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06) outline and a shadow of 0 8px 20px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.6).
  - Tab strip #1a1c1f, accent #6f9bea, text #ecebe8.

## 2. Scene
- One idea per tile: 2–4 moves that show "action → result", such as "click → a small window opens" or "change here → the other side syncs".
- Abstract wireframes only: no screenshots and no real text. Use at most one small icon where something needs to be recognisable.
- Motion: ease-out for movement, cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); a slight spring for appearing, cubic-bezier(.34,1.4,.64,1). Each move takes 250–600ms; the whole scene is done in about 3s.
- Icon chip: when the tile plays, its glyph redraws stroke by stroke (draw, pop or slide per part), then hands back to the solid icon.

## 3. Playback
- Resting styles are the final frame. Animations only describe where things come from (fill-mode: both or equivalent), so reduced motion shows the result and an interrupted play never jumps.
- The art panel fades in (opacity, plus translateY 6px and scale .97 to none) as its tile first plays.
- Play once in view: when about 70% of the tile is visible, wait ~200ms, then play. Tiles that enter together go ~250ms apart, in reading order. Stop on the final frame.
- One "played" state (a class or data attribute) drives every animation in the tile. To replay: remove it, force a reflow, add it back (or re-key in a framework).
- On mouse hover (mouse only) or keyboard focus, replay: blur the final frame out over ~160ms (blur 6px, opacity 0), restart under the blur, then clear it. Don't restart a play that hasn't finished.
- Optional loop on hover: while the pointer stays on the tile, replay again ~600ms after each play ends. When the pointer leaves, finish the current play and rest on the final frame.
- Touch: a tap follows the tile's link; nothing depends on hover.
- prefers-reduced-motion: reduce: no animation; show the final frame.

## 4. Colors and dark mode
- Every color is a variable on the art panel (panel, ring, texture, bars, windows, tab strip, accent, shadow); no hard-coded colors in the rules.
- Follow prefers-color-scheme, and the project's manual theme switch too (a class or data-theme), if it has one.
- Check it in both light and dark.

## 5. Delivery
- Mark the art as decorative (aria-hidden) and keep translatable text out of it.
- Check it in a real browser: first play, hover replay, keyboard focus, reduced motion, dark mode and a phone-width layout.

New series:  999 Tips to Make Your Vibe-Coded Product Feel Crafted

✨ 001 Skeuomorphic buttons with a satisfying click

One tip a day. Follow me so you don't miss the next 998.

Copy the prompt below ⬇️

Define a tactile, skeuomorphic Button component with five variants, from
strongest to weakest: primary, secondary, tertiary, ghost, text.
If the project already has a component library or design system, do not
add a new component: restyle its existing Button through its own variant
and token system, and keep its API, props and accessibility as they are.
Otherwise create one reusable Button with `variant` and `size` props.

Style: calm and precise, like the Lumno browser extension and the Cloudflare
dashboard. Neutral grays only, no brand hues. Lit from straight above.
No glossy Web 2.0 shine, no glow, no large blur.

Variants:
1. primary   - near-black slate face (#404859 -> #273042), white label
2. secondary - raised white key (#FFFFFF -> #F4F5F7), dark gray label
3. tertiary  - soft gray key (#F3F4F6 -> #E7E9EC), dark gray label
4. ghost     - no face at rest; faint gray fill on hover; a recessed well
               when pressed
5. text      - gray label with a thin underline and an arrow that nudges
               right on hover

Every filled variant is the same five material layers; only the values
change, so define them once as tokens and let each variant set its own:
1. Face: 180deg linear gradient, top 6-8% lighter than bottom.
2. Edge: 1px solid border one step darker than the bottom of the face
   (primary #12161F, secondary rgba(15,23,42,.14), tertiary rgba(15,23,42,.1)).
3. Top highlight: inset 0 1px 0 white (18% on slate, 85-100% on light
   faces). Put every inset layer in the button's own box-shadow, before the
   drop layers, never on a pseudo-element overlay: inset shadows on the
   element follow the inner radius (outer radius minus border), so the
   corners line up in every state.
4. Bottom shade: inset 0 -1px 0 black (22% on slate, 6% on light faces).
5. Drop shadow in two layers: a tight contact shadow 0 1px 2px plus a soft
   lift 0 4px 10px -3px (18% and 28% on slate, about a third of that on
   light faces).

States (hover, pressed/active, focus-visible, disabled):
- Hover: face one step lighter; the lift grows to 0 8px 16px -5px.

✨ 003 Dither 与 ASCII 参数化效果

001–003 都在我主页，关注我，每天一个让产品更有质感的小技巧

为你的登录页面/卡片添加可控的 Dither 与 ASCII 效果，并附带遮罩、色调、采样强度、大小、间距等可调参数。

两种效果怎么拆： 

ASCII：把画面切成网格，每格按亮度换成一个字符，从 “.” 到 “@” 越来越密。大小是字号，间距是格子疏密，采样强度是明暗对比，取样区域决定字画的是暗部还是亮部。 

Dither：把画面切成像素块，用 4×4 的 Bayer 矩阵当阈值，把每个颜色压成几级。大小是像素块，间距是纹理的尺度，采样强度越高，颜色级数越少，颗粒感越重。 两者都可以加一层遮罩，让画面退后，效果更像纹理而不是噪点。

推荐参数： 
ASCII：遮罩 90、取样暗部、采样强度 100、大小 37、间距 0 
Dither：遮罩 88、采样强度 100、大小 15、间距 0

Prompt 如下，可以直接抄 ⬇️

Add an ASCII / ordered-dither effect to one specific image or video in this project, with a live control panel next to it. Use the asset and the place I name (an , a , or a file path or URL, and the page or section it sits in); ask me if I have not named them. Apply the effect to that asset only, in place: keep its size, position, rounded corners and anything layered on top of it. If the project already has an image or canvas effect pipeline, or slider, segmented-control and panel components, build on them; otherwise create a reusable EffectLayer and EffectPanel.

Settings, one object shared by the layer and the panel: { filter: 'ascii' | 'dither', mask, palette, inkTone, strength, size, spacing } Keep separate values per filter, so switching filters brings back that filter's own settings.
What each control does in each filter, its range, and the recommended value (ASCII / Dither):

Mask effect, 0-100 (90 / 88): a vertical veil over the picture so the effect reads as texture rather than noise. Same in both filters.

Color, Original or one of five palettes (Original): gradient-maps the asset's luminance into one color family before filtering.
Sample tones, Shadows | Highlights (Shadows; ASCII only, hidden for Dither): which end of the tonal range becomes dense characters.
Sampling strength, 0-100 (100 / 100). ASCII: contrast of the tone curve and how bright and opaque the characters are. Dither: how few levels each color channel keeps (8 at 0, 2 at 100) and how fully the quantized color replaces the original.
Size, 0-100 (37 / 15). ASCII: font size, 7-24px. Dither: pixel block, 2-9px.
Spacing, 0-100 (0 / 0). ASCII: grid step, 8-24px across and 9-26px down, never tighter than the glyphs. Dither: scale of the Bayer pattern, 1-4 blocks per matrix cell.
Helpers used throughout:
range(v, a, b) = a + (b - a) * v / 100
luminance L = (0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B) / 255

s = strength / 100
"The box" is the asset's rendered size on the page.
Sampling:
Cover-fit the asset into the box and draw it into a small sampling canvas (about 480px on the long side), then read it with getImageData. A sample is the pixel under a point in the box, composited over white.
With a palette, recolor that canvas first: map each pixel's L through a 256-entry lookup built from the palette's four stops.

Per image or video frame, take about 12,000 evenly spaced samples: low = 8th percentile of L, high = 92nd percentile.
Shadows means dark ink, Highlights light ink.
ASCII:
Characters, from empty to full: " .,:;-=+xX08S#&@" (starts with two spaces).
Font: round(range(size, 7, 24))px monospace (22 instead of 24 when the box is under 720px wide), centered in each cell.

Grid: x step = max(range(spacing, 8, 24), widest glyph * 1.08); line height = max(range(spacing, 9, 26), height of "@" * 1.12, font * 1.04). The first cell sits half a step in from the edge.
Tone of a cell: raw = dark ink ? 1 - L : L; normalized = dark ink ? (high - L) / (high - low) : (L - low) / (high - low), clamped 0-1 (use raw alone when high - low < 0.025); mix = 0.72 + 0.14 s; t = raw (1 - mix) + normalized mix. Then a tone curve: black = 0.22 s, white = 1 - 0.08 s, lev = clamp((t - black) / (white - black), 0, 1), tone = lev (1 - s) + smoothstep(lev) s.
Skip cells with tone <= 0.02. Character = chars[round(tone * 16)]; skip spaces.
Ink: the sampled color lifted in HSV: value += (1 - value) * (0.24 + 0.18 s + 0.24 tone); saturation *= 1 + 0.16 + 0.2 s (clamped). Alpha = clamp((0.12 + 0.7 tone) (0.72 + 0.28 s), 0.06, 0.94).
Dither (ordered, Bayer 4x4):
pixel size = max(2, round(range(size, 2, 9))) (7 instead of 9 under 720px); pattern scale = max(1, round(range(spacing, 1, 4))); levels = max(2, round(range(strength, 8, 2))) per channel; blend = range(strength, 0.32, 1).
Matrix [[0,8,2,10],[12,4,14,6],[3,11,1,9],[15,7,13,5]]; threshold = (m + 0.5) / 16, indexed by floor(x / pattern scale), floor(y / pattern scale).

For each block sample its center, push saturation away from luma by 1 + 0.06 + 0.18 s, then per channel: scaled = c / 255 * (levels - 1); q = floor(scaled) + (fraction > threshold ? 1 : 0); out = c + (q / (levels - 1) * 255 - c) * blend.
Write the blocks into a canvas of box / pixel size and draw it scaled up with image smoothing off.
Mask and layering:
The mask is a vertical gradient with stops at the top, 42% and the bottom. Base opacities: on a light page white 54/20/38%, on a dark page black 44/20/50%. For a mask value v: stop = v <= 50 ? base * (v / 50)^1.08 : base + (100 - base) * ((v - 50) / 50)^1.08.
ASCII: draw the (recolored) picture, the mask, then the characters. Dither: draw the dithered picture, then the mask on top.

Changing filter or palette cross-fades from the last frame over 150ms.
Palettes (four stops at 0, 0.4, 0.74, 1):
meadow: #2B361F, #677D45, #AEBA78, #E5E1BD
blue: #192A4D, #326AC5, #A2C2F1, #EDF3FC
amber: #3C200F, #A74C15, #EF9A46, #F7E7CA
lavender: #292144, #6552AB, #B3A5E4, #F0ECFB

mono: #151515, #575757, #A6A6A6, #ECECEC
Rendering:
Draw into a canvas laid over the asset with the same size and corner radius, at devicePixelRatio capped at 1.6x and about 2048 x 2048.
Image: redraw when a setting changes (debounced 72ms).
Video: redraw on every new frame (requestVideoFrameCallback, falling back to requestAnimationFrame) while it plays and is on screen; keep the video element underneath as the source.
Control panel:

Place it next to the asset, below it when there is room, otherwise beside it, never covering it. About 420px wide, centered on the asset.
Rows, in order: Mask effect, Filter (two tabs: ASCII | Dither), Color (round swatches), Sample tones (ASCII only), Sampling strength, Size, Spacing (shown with %).
Each row 46px tall: a 136px label column, then the control. Slider: a 22px track with 8px radius and a filled part, a 9x30 rounded-rectangle thumb (3px radius), a number box with the value centered, and a snap mark at 50. Swatches: 22px circles, each filled with its palette's two middle stops at 135deg (Original: a tiny crop of the asset); the selected one gets a ring with a small gap.
Every change applies live while dragging. Add a "Reset to recommended" action that restores the values above for the current filter.

✨ 002 少数人才知道的级联菜单小技巧：添加安全区域延时。

什么是三角区？

 鼠标从父菜单斜着移向子菜单时，难免擦过下面几行。普通菜单一碰就切换，子菜单就“跑丢”了。

原理很简单：以鼠标上一刻的位置为顶点，连到子菜单靠近一侧的上下两个角，围成一个三角形。鼠标在三角形里，说明它正朝子菜单走，路过的行一律忽略；离开三角形，或者停留超过 1.2 秒，才切换到新的一行。

另外还有两个延时：悬停 220ms 后才打开子菜单；鼠标离开菜单 360ms 后才关闭。

Prompt 如下，可以直接抄 ⬇️

Define a cascading (nested) menu component that keeps its submenus steady: a safe zone plus three delays, so submenus open on purpose, survive diagonal moves toward them, and do not vanish on a brief slip out of the menu. If the project already has a menu or dropdown component, build this into its existing submenu logic and keep its API, keyboard support and accessibility as they are. Otherwise create one reusable CascadeMenu:

Props: an anchor (the trigger button that opens it on click) and a tree of items, each { label, icon?, href?, children? }. An item with children is a folder row; one without is a plain row that navigates on click.
Each level shows its folder's name as a small title above its rows.
Keyboard: arrow keys move through rows, Right/Enter opens a folder, Left goes back a level, Escape closes everything and returns focus to the anchor. Use menu / menuitem roles and aria-expanded on folder rows.
Behavior, with the values to use:

Open delay: hovering a row schedules it to take effect after 220ms: a folder row opens its submenu, a plain row closes any deeper submenu. Leaving the row before then cancels it. Touch input acts at once.
Safe zone: while a submenu is open, build a triangle from the pointer's previous position to the two corners of the submenu's near edge (the left edge's top and bottom for a submenu on the right). Track the last two pointermove positions and use the older one as the apex, so the triangle never collapses onto the current point. If the pointer is inside that triangle and within the parent's last min(90px, max(56px, 43% of the parent width)) toward the submenu, it is on its way there: rows it crosses must not highlight or open their own submenus.
Safe window: a row hovered inside the safe zone does not switch the submenu right away. Recheck every 80ms; switch once the pointer leaves the zone, or when 1200ms have passed since the hover began, so a pointer that simply stops there still gets its new submenu.
Close delay: when the pointer leaves the anchor, every open level and the safe zone, close the whole menu after 360ms. Coming back in time cancels the close. Clicking outside closes at once.
Dragging an item over a folder row opens it after 420ms instead of 220ms.
The pointer inside an open submenu ends all protection. Drive row highlight from component state (hovered, active, skipped), not from CSS :hover, or rows crossed inside the safe zone will still light up.
Geometry and motion:

Submenus open to the right, overlap their parent by 8px and align their first row with the parent row. Flip to the left when there is no room; the safe zone then uses the submenu's right edge.
Levels: 210-260px wide, sized to content, max height min(420px, 100vh - 24px) with their own scroll, 6px padding, 12px radius, 1px border, backdrop-filter blur(18px) saturate(135%).
Rows: 32px tall, 8px radius, 4px apart, 0 8px padding, 8px gap; 18px icon, 14px weight-500 label, a 16px chevron on folder rows. Level title: 11px, weight 600, quiet ink, padding 4px 8px 2px.
A submenu opens from its parent's edge: from translateX(-8px) scale(0.88, 0.98) and opacity 0, with opacity over 170ms and transform over 360ms on cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.45, 0.35, 1).
The root level opens the same way from its anchor: from translateY(-6px) scale(0.96, 0.86), top-left origin. Keep the overshoot curve: the slight spring is part of the feel.
A folder row's icon turns from a closed folder into an open one while its submenu is open, and back when it closes, over 460ms on cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Morph the paths if the two glyphs share their structure; otherwise cross-fade them with a slight lift of the front panel.
Light and dark themes come from tokens, not separate components:

Light: surface rgba(255,255,255,.96), border rgba(0,0,0,.14), row ink #263140, row hover rgba(15,23,42,.07), quiet ink #7A8491, chevron #94A3B8, shadow 0 18px 34px rgba(15,23,42,.12), 0 2px 4px rgba(15,23,42,.05), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.74).
Dark, neutral grays with no blue cast: surface rgba(34,34,34,.96), border rgba(255,255,255,.12), row ink #E4E4E4, row hover rgba(255,255,255,.08), quiet ink #9A9A9A, chevron #8A8A8A, shadow 0 18px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.42), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.2), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06).
Monochrome brand icons invert in dark. Switching themes cross-fades colors, borders and shadows over about 500ms.
Keep every timing value as a named constant in one place, and keep the safe-zone math in a pure, unit-tested helper (point-in-triangle by the sign of the three edge cross products). Add an optional debug overlay that draws the zone (blue fill at 16%, dashed blue outline) and the running timer, off by default.

Every filled variant is the same five material layers; only the values
change, so define them once as tokens and let each variant set its own:
1. Face: 180deg linear gradient, top 6-8% lighter than bottom.
2. Edge: 1px solid border one step darker than the bottom of the face
   (primary #12161F, secondary rgba(15,23,42,.14), tertiary rgba(15,23,42,.1)).
3. Top highlight: inset 0 1px 0 white (18% on slate, 85-100% on light
   faces). Put every inset layer in the button's own box-shadow, before the
   drop layers, never on a pseudo-element overlay: inset shadows on the
   element follow the inner radius (outer radius minus border), so the
   corners line up in every state.
4. Bottom shade: inset 0 -1px 0 black (22% on slate, 6% on light faces).
5. Drop shadow in two layers: a tight contact shadow 0 1px 2px plus a soft
   lift 0 4px 10px -3px (18% and 28% on slate, about a third of that on
   light faces).

States (hover, pressed/active, focus-visible, disabled):
- Hover: face one step lighter; the lift grows to 0 8px 16px -5px.
- Pressed: translateY(1px); flip the gradient (darker on top); the outer
  shadow collapses to 0 1px 1px; the top highlight becomes an inner shadow,
  inset 0 1px 2px black (40% on slate, 12-16% on light faces). Light faces
  keep a 1px white line below, 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9), like a key
  pressed into paper.
- Give rest and pressed the same number of inset layers (pad with
  inset 0 0 0 transparent) so the shadow animates instead of jumping.
- Focus-visible and disabled follow the library's existing conventions.
- Timing: 120ms for transform, 140ms for shadows, 160ms for colors.

Sizes: all values above are for the 14px label size: height 40px,
padding 0 18px, radius 10px, label weight 600, optional 16px leading icon.
On the slate face add a label text-shadow 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.28).
Scale the material with the type, never keep it at fixed pixels: express
every length (height, padding, radius, border, icon, the 1px press offset,
and every shadow offset, blur and spread) as a multiple of a size unit
u = label size / 14. Provide two sizes: md (14px label, u = 1px) and
lg (16px label, u = 16/14 px, so height 45.7px, radius 11.4px, lift shadow
0 4.6px 11.4px -3.4px).

画布与底板
- viewBox 0 0 160 120，圆角 18 的底板铺满画布。

- 浏览器窗口顶部是 18 高的标签条 #eef1f5，激活的标签是白色，圆角 5。
- 文字一律用占位条代替：普通 4 高 #e5e9ef，标题 5 高 #cdd4de，两端全圆角。
- 空格子 #f1f3f6；露在后面的卡片 #f3f3f4。
- 图标只用 Remix icon的线性款。普通图标 #a3abb7，次要操作 #6b7280。
- 只有一个强调色元素，表示下一步操作（按钮、重试、新增）；没有下一步就不用强调色。强调色 #3462ad。按键或主按钮用石板灰渐变 #404859 → #273042，上面配白色图标。

深色模式
- 底板 #26262b，斜纹 rgba(255,255,255,0.035)，表面 #323238，标签条 #2a2a2f，占位条 #3f3f47 / #52525b，图标 #7d828c，强调色 #7ea6ea，阴影黑色、不透明度 0.36。
- 颜色写成 CSS 变量，放在 SVG 内部的 <style> 里，并用 SVG 自己的 id 限定作用域。根元素写 data-theme="light|dark|auto"；auto 跟随 prefers-color-scheme。

构图
- 画的是这个空状态在真实界面里的样子，按比例简化；不要抽象符号。
- 一个场景，2–3 个物体，外接框居中于 (80, 60)，四周留白至少 14。
- 不要文字、人物、渐变插画背景，也不要半透明物体互相叠加。

技术
- 不引用外部资源，不用 <image> 或 <use>。
- 阴影用 feGaussianBlur + feOffset + feFlood + feComposite + feMerge 拼出来，不要用 feDropShadow（有些 HTML 解析器会把它的名字转成小写）。
- 所有 id 都带上同一个随机前缀，同一页放多张图也不会冲突。
- 可选动画：强调色元素在 prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference 时做一次缩放弹出，用 transform-box: fill-box。

1. 用好产品的设计资产：在设计 Lumno 时，我几乎从 0 打造了一套组件库，从功能、内容自适应到样式。这套东西也可以应用在官网上。

2. 拆解，并让 Opus 自己找竞品：Opus 搜刮竞品的能力很强，且大多数时候很能 Get 到竞品的优秀点。比如我想做 Footer，我可以让他直接参考 Racycast，或者去 Product Hunt 上找 10 个 Top Mac 应用，分析其官网的 footer 构成。【不要怕自己没有 Taste，只需要让 AI 逐个去找网站每个部分中最好的参考即可】

3. 引导阅读顺序：首屏提出品牌主张+强 CTA 转化按钮；Section2 放核心卖点。以此类推，补充用户背书、惊喜小功能等，FAQ 聚焦 Github 或用户群里的高频问题，最后 Footer 前再把首屏放一次——好比 PPT 末尾需要再次 call back。

4. 基于优化 SEO 的思想组织内容：如果你不知道网站放哪些内容，就让 Opus 输出一个通用的能满足 SEO 要求的模板，然后再去手动加内容。可以多看看 @loki_yan_seo 老师的推文。

5. 善用 SVG 动画：Opus 5.5 的动画能力很强，可以让它基于产品功能直出演示小动画/截图。

6. 考虑移动端，特别是 iPhone 用户的阅读体验：iOS 的浏览器基本都是 Webkit 套壳，即使是在微信打开，亦是如此。你在 Chromium 浏览器上看到的样式，未必能正常工作。

7. 写“好”文案：Claude 写的 AI 味重，就让他去参考 Apple 的文案。官网首页，让他去学习广告文案怎么写、怎么说明痛点、怎么抖包袱、怎么呼应诉求；Wiki 文案，让他学习专业的组件库、设计规范文档。

8. 做好多语言：让 AI 意译，甚至可以基于目标语言人群的文化志趣、表达习惯、网络热梗来自由修改。

分享一些在 Vibe 时的小心得：

1. 在 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 中提前约定代码结构与模块边界，要求 AI 在实现前先做好结构设计。否则，项目很容易演变成“一个 JS 文件塞进数万行代码”的局面。

2. 每完成一个小功能后，可以让 AI 主动整理相关代码，例如：“请重构这部分代码，避免补丁式堆叠，并提升稳定性，排查潜在性能问题。”在持续调整细节时，AI 很容易用“补丁叠补丁”的方式完成任务，因此需要阶段性收拢与清理。

3. 让 AI 提取产品中的样式、色彩、字号、间距等规范，并整理成 Design.md；也可以要求它“将某个功能封装为可复用组件，并以组件库的形式维护，方便后续调用。若后续需要修改，优先在组件层面调整，而不是引入一次性的特殊样式。”

4. 在预览前端还原效果时，可以要求 AI 使用 Chrome DevTools MCP 或 Computer Use 进行自查。只有当界面符合预期或贴近设计稿时，才结束当前任务。

5. 在调试某个功能块或组件时，可以要求 AI 采用 isolated component preview harness 的思路，将其单独渲染到一个临时页面中，集中检查布局、间距、动效、截图和 DOM 状态。

分享一个容易被忽视的产品设计细节：如何避免级联菜单误触⬇️

今天给 Lumno 做多级书签菜单时，想起很经典的「安全三角区」。

当用户从父菜单 A 移向子菜单 B 时，系统会用“当前光标位置”和“子菜单上下边界”动态构成一个三角区域。只要光标仍在这个区域内，就暂缓切换到路过的其他菜单项。

这样用户按最自然的直线路径移动时，不会因为扫过下方菜单项，导致目标子菜单被意外关闭。

这是一个很小的 hover intent 设计，但对体验影响很大。做级联菜单时，可以把这三件事一起考虑：开启延时、关闭延时、安全三角区。

这种细节 AI 不一定会主动想到。做交互类需求时，可以把「安全三角区」这个概念明确告诉它。

为什么你在小红书分享的「专业内容」总是无人问津？如何借助「流量池机制」加热内容？

分享 8 个发帖 Tricks ⬇️ 欢迎友好讨论～

1️⃣ 附带一个无需动脑、引导性的投票。
✨ 对于算法而言，点赞、评论、收藏、转发是 4 种主要的提升权重的行为，投票是你可人为添加的第 5 种。增加一种交互触点，就更容易引发互动，进而使帖子被判定为优质。

2️⃣ 带定位。
✨ 定位对小红书内容推荐的影响权重很高。假如你分享的是专业内容，且目标受众是上班族，那么就把定位改到你所在城市的几个大的工区或商圈。

3️⃣ 定时发布。
✨ 娱乐内容赶在受众休闲的时间发，专业内容赶在受众上班路上或摸鱼时间发，工作日早上 8:00 时间极好。

4️⃣ 重图而非文字。
✨ 用户更爱看图，首先看到的也是图。把文字加到图里，笔记的文字区建议用来补充必要信息，而非用于长篇大论。

5️⃣ 打关联性强的 TAG
✨ 打语义/逻辑相关性较高的 TAG，这样内容更易被判定为“垂直”。TAG 不是越多越好。

6️⃣ 发布后马上转发，用好私域
✨ 如果你有一些群，或者某些社媒平台（甚至朋友圈）有很多粉丝，发布之后马上转发，用你已经积攒的影响力来帮你的笔记加热，更容易进入大流量池。

7️⃣ 积极回复评论。
✨ 回复也可算作互动，故不再赘述。

8️⃣ 讲痛点而非讲技术
✨ 小红书是泛娱乐平台，但却对极垂直的内容友好。发帖的宗旨是“利他”，因此要有共情力。

小红书上成功的专业内容都有一个特性，那就是把极其专业的知识点用大白话讲出来（或用生动的形式展示出来），且完美贴合到了受众的需求

——要么是帮受众解决了问题，要么是帮受众满足了收藏癖，要么是给受众提供了情绪价值。

分享几个配置的时候遇见的坑：

1. 🐟搜高通 410 openwrt 的棒子/随身 wifi 即可，具体是哪家没关系。建议买刷好系统的，省去找固件刷机的心力；

2. 硬件到手需要搭配一个 5v2a 的 usb type A 充电头，或者插在电脑蓝色的 USB 口上，否则电流不足，很多功能启用后会马上自动关闭；

3. 需要用 ADB 把脚本写入，这些硬件通常自带 ADB；

4. 用 openwrt 网页后台连 wifi 时，如果出现保存后设备马上重启，修改丢失的情况，可能是因为 2；或者可以直接让 AI 通过 ADB 帮你改，成功率高；

5. 尽量连接家里的 2.4Ghz 的网络，需要通过 bark 的服务器转发；

6. 如果出现奇怪的问题，物理插拔重启是最有效的方法；

关于 Sim 卡：
1. 需要 Standard 大小的 Sim 卡，小卡片可以美团搜“卡托”，或者与运营商找一个壳子套上；

2. ❗️❗️如果你的 Sim 卡不能被识别（以我的 Clubsim 为例），先不要以为是不支持该运营商，很可能是因为 Sim 卡太薄，而硬件的卡槽比较粗糙，导致电流不足。此时塞一个大小近似的纸片进去即可；

3. 信号建议保持在 40% 以上，notion 里有指令可查。这种硬件的性能通常较差，建议将其安置在室外，或者远离大量电子设备的地方。
